parameters.query:
SELECT i.incident_id, i.service, i.environment, i.severity, i.state, i.revision,
       i.current_version, i.healthy_version, i.summary,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'event_id',e.event_id,'event_type',e.event_type,'source',e.source,
         'occurred_at',e.occurred_at,'correlation_hint',e.correlation_hint,
         'relationship',ie.relationship,'metadata',e.metadata) ORDER BY e.occurred_at,e.event_id)
         FROM ir_incident_events ie JOIN ir_events e ON e.event_id=ie.event_id
         WHERE ie.incident_id=i.incident_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS events,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
         'evidence_key',v.evidence_key,'kind',v.kind,'summary',v.summary,
         'source_event_id',v.source_event_id,'payload',v.payload) ORDER BY v.evidence_id)
         FROM ir_evidence v WHERE v.incident_id=i.incident_id), '[]'::jsonb) AS evidence
FROM ir_incidents i
WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR i.incident_id=$1::text) AND i.environment='production-demo' AND i.state='INVESTIGATING'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ir_incident_events ie JOIN ir_events e ON e.event_id=ie.event_id
              WHERE ie.incident_id=i.incident_id AND e.event_type='health.failed')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ir_incident_events ie JOIN ir_events e ON e.event_id=ie.event_id WHERE ie.incident_id=i.incident_id AND e.event_type='checkout.failed')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ir_assessments a WHERE a.incident_id=i.incident_id AND a.revision=i.revision)
ORDER BY i.updated_at,i.incident_id LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
WITH incident AS (
  UPDATE ir_incidents SET current_version=$3, healthy_version=COALESCE($4,healthy_version), updated_at=NOW()
  WHERE incident_id=$1 AND revision=$2::integer AND state='INVESTIGATING'
  RETURNING incident_id, revision, service, environment, severity, state, current_version, healthy_version, summary
), supplementary AS (
  SELECT jsonb_array_elements($5::jsonb) AS item
), saved_evidence AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_evidence (incident_id,evidence_key,kind,summary,source_event_id,payload)
  SELECT incident.incident_id, item->>'evidence_key', item->>'kind', item->>'summary',
         NULLIF(item->>'source_event_id','')::text, COALESCE(item->'payload','{}'::jsonb)
  FROM incident CROSS JOIN supplementary
  ON CONFLICT (incident_id,evidence_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING evidence_key
), claim AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_assessments (incident_id,revision,status,provider,model,assessment)
  SELECT incident_id,revision,'pending','nvidia-nim','openai/gpt-oss-20b','{}'::jsonb FROM incident
  ON CONFLICT (incident_id,revision) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING assessment_id,incident_id,revision
)
SELECT incident.incident_id,incident.revision,incident.service,incident.environment,incident.severity,incident.state,
       incident.current_version,incident.healthy_version,incident.summary,claim.assessment_id,
       $6::jsonb AS evidence_bundle,$7::jsonb AS compact_evidence,$8::jsonb AS nim_request,
       NULLIF($9::text,'') AS fixture_mode,$10::text AS source,
       $11::boolean AS has_health_failure,$12::boolean AS has_checkout_failure,$13::bigint AS nim_started_at_ms
FROM incident JOIN claim ON claim.incident_id=incident.incident_id AND claim.revision=incident.revision;

nodes.name: Persist Findings and Claim Assessment Revision
Ask NVIDIA NIM for Advisory Assessment
Capture NIM Response or Provider Failure
Validate JSON Schema and Evidence References

parameters.query:
WITH current_incident AS (
  SELECT state,revision FROM ir_incidents WHERE incident_id=$1
), saved AS (
  UPDATE ir_assessments a SET
    status=CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current_incident i WHERE i.state='INVESTIGATING' AND i.revision=$2::integer) THEN $3 ELSE 'stale' END,
    provider=$4, model=$5, duration_ms=$6::integer,
    assessment=COALESCE($7::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb), validation_errors=COALESCE($8::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb)
  WHERE a.assessment_id=$9::bigint AND a.incident_id=$1 AND a.revision=$2::integer
  RETURNING a.incident_id,a.revision,a.status,a.model,a.duration_ms
)
SELECT * FROM saved;

WITH context AS (
  SELECT i.incident_id,i.service,i.environment,i.severity,i.state,i.revision,i.current_version,i.healthy_version,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ir_incident_events ie JOIN ir_events e ON e.event_id=ie.event_id WHERE ie.incident_id=i.incident_id AND e.event_type='health.failed') AS has_health,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ir_incident_events ie JOIN ir_events e ON e.event_id=ie.event_id WHERE ie.incident_id=i.incident_id AND e.event_type='checkout.failed') AS has_checkout,
    COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT ev.evidence_key) FROM ir_evidence ev WHERE ev.incident_id=i.incident_id),'[]'::jsonb) AS evidence_refs
  FROM ir_incidents i
  WHERE i.incident_id=$1 AND i.revision=$2::integer AND i.state='INVESTIGATING'
), policy AS (
  SELECT *, (service='checkout-api' AND environment='production-demo' AND has_health AND has_checkout
             AND current_version IS NOT NULL AND healthy_version IS NOT NULL AND current_version<>healthy_version) AS eligible
  FROM context
), transitioned AS (
  UPDATE ir_incidents i SET state='WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL',updated_at=NOW()
  FROM policy d
  WHERE i.incident_id=d.incident_id AND i.revision=d.revision AND i.state='INVESTIGATING' AND d.eligible
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ir_proposals p WHERE p.incident_id=i.incident_id AND p.revision=i.revision)
  RETURNING i.incident_id,i.revision,i.state,d.current_version,d.healthy_version,d.evidence_refs
), proposal AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_proposals (incident_id,revision,action_type,source_version,target_version,reason,evidence_refs,status,expires_at)
  SELECT incident_id,revision,'rollback',current_version,healthy_version,
         'Deterministic policy: health and checkout both failed; a prior successful release is available.',
         evidence_refs,'PROPOSED',NOW()+interval '15 minutes'
  FROM transitioned
  RETURNING proposal_id,incident_id,revision,action_type,source_version,target_version,expires_at
), token_value AS (SELECT gen_random_uuid() AS token), approval AS (
  INSERT INTO ir_approvals (proposal_id,proposal_revision,action_type,source_version,target_version,delivery_token,token_hash,status,expires_at)
  SELECT p.proposal_id,p.revision,p.action_type,p.source_version,p.target_version,t.token,
         encode(digest(t.token::text,'sha256'),'hex'),'PENDING',p.expires_at
  FROM proposal p CROSS JOIN token_value t
  RETURNING approval_id,proposal_id,status,expires_at
)
SELECT policy.incident_id,policy.revision,policy.eligible,
       proposal.proposal_id,proposal.source_version,proposal.target_version,proposal.expires_at AS proposal_expires_at,
       approval.approval_id,approval.status AS approval_status,approval.expires_at AS approval_expires_at,
       transitioned.state AS incident_state,
       CASE WHEN transitioned.incident_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'proposal_created'
            WHEN NOT policy.eligible THEN 'policy_not_eligible'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ir_proposals p WHERE p.incident_id=policy.incident_id AND p.revision=policy.revision) THEN 'proposal_already_exists'
            ELSE 'stale_revision_or_transition' END AS result
FROM policy LEFT JOIN proposal ON proposal.incident_id=policy.incident_id
LEFT JOIN approval ON approval.proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id
LEFT JOIN transitioned ON transitioned.incident_id=policy.incident_id;
